how_measured: Offline replay of session traces through recorder::detect (the rules the application runs), polling at the interval of the preset and applying each trace event at the first poll at or after its time. A trace lists audio sessions (playback and microphone, state, coarse peak none/low/high) and, where labelled, Meet events and the applications being recorded; it holds no audio. Prompts are never answered in a replay, so a call is prompted once and ends after the end-of-call time without a signal. A prompt inside a labelled call of the same application counts for that call (the first one is the prompt, later ones are duplicates); any other prompt is false; a call without a prompt is missed; delay is the time from the start of the call to its prompt.
name: stage6-detection-high
not_yet_measured: A working day (8 h) of real use: record one with record_session_trace --minutes 480 and add the anonymized file to the trace folder.
Real Discord, Teams (new and classic) and Zoom calls: the state of their microphone and playback sessions during a call, a mute and a device check.

traces_are.real: enumeration of the audio sessions of the reference machine while it was idle (no call), anonymized: process ids replaced by their order, programs other than the known conferencing applications named app-N, no device or display names
traces_are.synthetic: made by hand to exercise one situation each (a call, a device check, a microphone test, voice search, dictation, muted call, back-to-back calls, an application that is being recorded, Meet). They are NOT recordings of real calls: the sequences of session states in them are assumptions about how Discord, Teams and a browser behave, which a measurement on real calls has to confirm
